It also won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical when it made its West End debut in 2015, and it began a US tour in 2014.

task_results.final_answer: Kinky Boots (the 2012–2013 Broadway musical) was initially less well received by theatre critics and at the box office than the other 2013 Broadway production Matilda the Musical, but it surpassed Matilda in weekly box office gross less than a month after opening. After winning the Tony Award for Best Musical and five other Tonys, it enjoyed a post‑Tony boost in advance sales. It also won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical when it made its West End debut in 2015, and it began a US tour in 2014.

Kinky Boots (the 2012–2013 Broadway musical) was initially less well received by theatre critics and at the box office than the other 2013 Broadway production Matilda the Musical, but it surpassed Matilda in weekly box office gross less than a month after opening. After winning the Tony Award for Best Musical and five other Tonys, it enjoyed a post‑Tony boost in advance sales. It also won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical when it made its West End debut in 2015, and it began a US tour in 2014.

task_results.prediction: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.

response.content: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.

outputs.summarizer: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.

history.question: who wrote the music and lyrics to the song kinky boots
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper wrote the music and lyrics to the song "Kinky Boots."

history.question: who is the singer?
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper

history.question: whose story does the musical convey?
history.answer: The musical *Kinky Boots* conveys the story of Charlie Price, who inherited a shoe factory from his father.

history.question: when was its release?
history.answer: October 2012

history.question: what was the response it received?
history.answer: Kinky Boots (the 2012–2013 Broadway musical) was initially less well received by theatre critics and at the box office than the other 2013 Broadway production Matilda the Musical, but it surpassed Matilda in weekly box office gross less than a month after opening. After winning the Tony Award for Best Musical and five other Tonys, it enjoyed a post‑Tony boost in advance sales. It also won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical when it made its West End debut in 2015, and it began a US tour in 2014.

task_results.final_answer: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.

The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.

history.question: who wrote the music and lyrics to the song kinky boots
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper wrote the music and lyrics to the song "Kinky Boots."

history.question: who is the singer?
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper

history.question: whose story does the musical convey?
history.answer: The musical *Kinky Boots* conveys the story of Charlie Price, who inherited a shoe factory from his father.

history.question: when was its release?
history.answer: October 2012

history.question: what was the response it received?
history.answer: Kinky Boots (the 2012–2013 Broadway musical) was initially less well received by theatre critics and at the box office than the other 2013 Broadway production Matilda the Musical, but it surpassed Matilda in weekly box office gross less than a month after opening. After winning the Tony Award for Best Musical and five other Tonys, it enjoyed a post‑Tony boost in advance sales. It also won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical when it made its West End debut in 2015, and it began a US tour in 2014.

history.question: what can you tell me about the songwriter?
history.answer: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.

history.question: who wrote the music and lyrics to the song kinky boots
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper wrote the music and lyrics to the song "Kinky Boots."

history.question: who is the singer?
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper

history.question: whose story does the musical convey?
history.answer: The musical *Kinky Boots* conveys the story of Charlie Price, who inherited a shoe factory from his father.

history.question: when was its release?
history.answer: October 2012

history.question: what was the response it received?
history.answer: Kinky Boots (the 2012–2013 Broadway musical) was initially less well received by theatre critics and at the box office than the other 2013 Broadway production Matilda the Musical, but it surpassed Matilda in weekly box office gross less than a month after opening. After winning the Tony Award for Best Musical and five other Tonys, it enjoyed a post‑Tony boost in advance sales. It also won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical when it made its West End debut in 2015, and it began a US tour in 2014.

history.question: what can you tell me about the songwriter?
history.answer: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.

history.question: who wrote the music and lyrics to the song kinky boots
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper wrote the music and lyrics to the song "Kinky Boots."

history.question: who is the singer?
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper

history.question: whose story does the musical convey?
history.answer: The musical *Kinky Boots* conveys the story of Charlie Price, who inherited a shoe factory from his father.

history.question: when was its release?
history.answer: October 2012

history.question: what was the response it received?
history.answer: Kinky Boots (the 2012–2013 Broadway musical) was initially less well received by theatre critics and at the box office than the other 2013 Broadway production Matilda the Musical, but it surpassed Matilda in weekly box office gross less than a month after opening. After winning the Tony Award for Best Musical and five other Tonys, it enjoyed a post‑Tony boost in advance sales. It also won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical when it made its West End debut in 2015, and it began a US tour in 2014.

history.question: what can you tell me about the songwriter?
history.answer: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.

history.question: when did she begin her career?
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper began her career in 1983, the year her debut solo studio album, *She's So Unusual*, was released.

history.question: who wrote the music and lyrics to the song kinky boots
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper wrote the music and lyrics to the song "Kinky Boots."

history.question: who is the singer?
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper

history.question: whose story does the musical convey?
history.answer: The musical *Kinky Boots* conveys the story of Charlie Price, who inherited a shoe factory from his father.

history.question: when was its release?
history.answer: October 2012

history.question: what was the response it received?
history.answer: Kinky Boots (the 2012–2013 Broadway musical) was initially less well received by theatre critics and at the box office than the other 2013 Broadway production Matilda the Musical, but it surpassed Matilda in weekly box office gross less than a month after opening. After winning the Tony Award for Best Musical and five other Tonys, it enjoyed a post‑Tony boost in advance sales. It also won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical when it made its West End debut in 2015, and it began a US tour in 2014.

history.question: what can you tell me about the songwriter?
history.answer: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.

history.question: when did she begin her career?
history.answer: Cyndi Lauper began her career in 1983, the year her debut solo studio album, *She's So Unusual*, was released.

history.question: which is her debut work?
history.answer: She's So Unusual

history.question: who released the album?
history.answer: Portrait Records released the album *She's So Unusual*.

return_result.answer: Kinky Boots (the 2012–2013 Broadway musical) was initially less well received by theatre critics and at the box office than the other 2013 Broadway production Matilda the Musical, but it surpassed Matilda in weekly box office gross less than a month after opening. After winning the Tony Award for Best Musical and five other Tonys, it enjoyed a post‑Tony boost in advance sales. It also won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical when it made its West End debut in 2015, and it began a US tour in 2014.

return_result.content: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.

return_result.answer: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She composed the music and lyrics for the Broadway musical *Kinky Boots*, which was based on the 2005 British film of the same name. *Kinky Boots* won the Tony Award for Best Musical and the Laurence Olivier Award for Best New Musical. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. VH1 named her the 58th-greatest woman in rock and roll.
return_result.final_answer: The songwriter is Cyndi Lauper (Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. Lauper has received numerous accolades, including two Grammy Awards, a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album (2014), a Tony Award, a Primetime Emmy Award, four MTV Video Music Awards, four Billboard Music Awards, two American Music Awards, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
